LanguageData.Gun_Skorpion_SA_Vz61_RWP.label: Skorpion vz.61
LanguageData.Gun_Skorpion_SA_Vz61_RWP.description: The Skorpion vz.61 is a compact automatic weapon known for its versatility and ease of use. Originally designed for use by military and security forces, it combines elements of a submachine gun and a machine pistol, making it an effective choice for close-quarters combat. Its balanced design offers a moderate firing rate and manageable recoil, suitable for pawns needing a lightweight yet powerful firearm.
